leadText: Pokémon Adventures: Agatha's Arbok is the thirty-third monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters twenty-nine, thirty, and thirty-one of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

It contains chapters twenty-nine, thirty, and thirty-one of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
